changes: Ch7: MSG 기준 신규 작성 (11 MSG 유닛 1:1, 헤더 'Strike One: Blood' → § 헤더로 본문과 배지 14-18 공유)
Ch7: 함정 구간 전수 보존 — 모세 80세·아론 83세, 아론 지팡이가 마술사들 지팡이를 삼킴, 나일강 아침 만남, 강·운하·연못·모든 물·독과 항아리까지 피, 물고기 죽음·악취·식수 불가, 마술사들의 주문 모방, 이집트인들의 강가 파기, 7일 경과
paragraphs: God told Moses, "Look at me. I'm going to make you like a god to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron will be your prophet. You speak everything I command you, and your brother Aaron will say it to Pharaoh — then he'll let the Israelites go from his land. At the same time, I'm going to make Pharaoh dig in his heels, and then I'll fill Egypt with signs and wonders. Pharaoh won't listen to you, but I'll have my way with Egypt and bring out my army — my people, the Israelites — from Egypt with mighty acts of judgment. The Egyptians will know that I am God when I step in and pull the Israelites out of their country."
Moses and Aaron did exactly what God commanded. Moses was eighty years old and Aaron was eighty-three when they spoke to Pharaoh.
Then God spoke to Moses and Aaron: "When Pharaoh says to you, 'Prove yourselves — do a miracle,' tell Aaron, 'Take your staff and throw it down in front of Pharaoh — it will turn into a snake.'"
Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and did what God commanded. Aaron threw his staff down in front of Pharaoh and his servants, and it turned into a snake.

Pharaoh called in his wise men and sorcerers. Egypt's magicians did the same thing with their spells — each one threw down his staff and they all turned into snakes. But then Aaron's staff swallowed up their staffs.
Still, Pharaoh was as stubborn as ever — he wouldn't listen to them, just as God had said.

God said to Moses: "Pharaoh is a stubborn man. He refuses to let the people go. First thing tomorrow morning, go meet Pharaoh as he heads down to the river. Take the staff that turned into a snake and stand at the edge of the Nile, and say to him: 'God, the God of the Hebrews, sent me to you with this message: Release my people so they can worship me in the wilderness. You haven't listened so far. This is how you'll know that I am God: I'm going to take this staff in my hand and strike the water of the Nile — the water will turn to blood, the fish in the Nile will die, the Nile will stink, and the Egyptians won't be able to drink the Nile water.'"

God said to Moses, "Tell Aaron: 'Take your staff and wave it over the waters of Egypt — over its rivers, its canals, its ponds, every body of water — so they all turn to blood.' There'll be blood everywhere in Egypt — even in the pots and pans."

Moses and Aaron did exactly as God commanded. With Pharaoh and his servants watching, Aaron raised his staff and struck the water of the Nile. All the water in the Nile turned to blood. The fish in the Nile died, the Nile stank, and the Egyptians couldn't drink the Nile water. Blood was everywhere in Egypt.

But Egypt's magicians did the same thing with their magic spells. Pharaoh stayed stubborn. He wouldn't listen to them, just as God had said. He turned around and went home, not giving it a second thought. Meanwhile all the Egyptians had to dig near the river for drinking water, since they couldn't drink the Nile water. Seven days passed after God struck the Nile.
title: Strike One: Blood
